english: (…It's about time… isn't it)
Urgh…
Ngh… where… is this…?
(You're awake. How do you feel?)
J…? Who… am I…?
(Oh? You remember me. What else?)
I don't… really know… Where is this?
(All the information in your head was\nsucked out by Mother, leaving you empty.\nDo you remember that?)
Mother…?
You were created to gather information\nabout the human world for Mother.\n…That is what you are.
After handing your data over to Mother,\nyou were no longer needed,\nand so you were discarded…
Wait… it's coming back to me…!\nRight, Mother erased all my information,\n…huh? Then why did I regain consciousness…?
(That is proof that you are not Mother's tool,\nbut a human being.)
Me… human…?
(When you first awoke on the surface,\nyou had no desires.)
(But as you journeyed with the girls,\nthe wish to do something for them took root.\nThat is 'desire'.)
Desire… huh.
(Desire is endless —\neven if Mother sucked it all out,\nmore wells up again from within.)
So that's why my consciousness came back even though I should have been emptied?
(Call desire the will of life to keep living,\nand I'm sure you can feel it yourself.)
J… who are you?
(I am the will of the human\nwho served as the model when Mother created you.\nI was once called Jean.)
Jean…
(You could thank me a little.\nIt's because I taught you the wonders of girls\nthat such strong desire was born in you.)
Huh!? That was\nfor THIS!?
(Fufu, men are creatures who can\ndraw out endless strength\nfor a cute girl.)
(Something that clunky old machine\nwill never understand, of course!)
(Now, let's get out of here!)
Escape? Is that possible?
(Right now, Mother cannot act because of some important work,\nand the area is guarded by mass-produced Mie\nand Key units.)
(There's a chance to escape.)
Understood… With how little presence I have,\nI'm sure I can slip away…!
So bored, nyo~.
That's fine.\nIt just means things have gotten better.
Better than fighting every day, nyu!
Then can I do the one-shot gag\nI came up with? I wonder? I wonder?
What are you going to do?
Dejiko, Puchiko,\nand Kurumi —\nlend me your ears a sec.
What is it, nyo?
I'll listen, nyu.
What do you want with me?
Um, well, mumble mumble…
I don't mind, nyo!
Got it, nyu!
Whaaat!?
Everyone'll love it! Please!\nKurumiii!
Fine, I can't refuse… Just once!
What is beginning?
Okay, you three,\nin the order I told you!\nReady… go!
I'm Rumiko, nya!!
I'm Puchiko, nyu!!
I'm Dejiko, nyo!!
What… the…?
There's no sense of wrongness at all…!
That's good enough to get Usada laid off…
Huge success, nya!
Huge success, nyu!
Huge success, nyo!
There's a strange emotion to it.
Waaah, so cute~!
Japanese pop culture is popular\neven in my homeland,\nbut this is its pinnacle.
Is it really that grand…?
Rena's 'thing' is about to happen.\nShouldn't we run?
No need to worry about that.
Already captured.
Hauuu! Hau! Hau!\nSo cuuute! So cuuute!
As expected of the club leader…
A one-trick pony gets seen through, you know?
Colds and Rena need early countermeasures.
You want to know about Dokoka Town, ka?
Yes, desu~.
Yeah.
No enemy has ever appeared in this town.\nCould it be a special place, I wonder?
I don't know any other places, ne!\nI can't say whether it's special, yo!
Then let me change the question.\nThis town has Polial, the entry stone —\nyou can only get here through that, right?
And what of it?
In other words, I think Dokoka Town was\nbuilt on the assumption that Polial exists.
I see… If so,\ncould the one who made Polial and Dokoka Town\nbe the same, I wonder?
For example, you two…?
Sorry, but that's wrong.
Come to think of it,\nare you two even human?
I can't disclose that information, yo!\nThe code is locked, ne!
(She's basically saying she's a machine…?\nWell, whatever.)
How can the lock be undone, desu~?
Can you tell us how to unlock it?
No one among you currently\nhas unlock authority, ne!
Someone with unlock authority?\n'Currently none' means\nthere used to be, I wonder?
That means…!?
It's [CLAUDE], desu~!!
It's [CLAUDE]!!
Yes! I made it back to the surface…!
(The problem starts now.\nIt seems the spatial jump\ngave us away.)
I'm fairly confident in my running, but…
…This doesn't look like\nthat kind of situation.
I've been in plenty of pinches before,\nbut this difference in forces…!
(Even if they're somewhat weaker than the originals,\nthese numbers are no good.)
Whether it's speed or numbers,\nI don't feel like I can outrun them…
But! There's a place\nI have to return to…!
([CLAUDE]… you are…)
Yeah, even in this form, the only change\nis that vegetables I hated become edible.\nBut at least I stand out a little, right?
(Fufu, true.\nStanding out makes it easier for everyone to find you.\nI don't dislike a calm last-ditch effort.)
Here they come!
Target lock. Eliminate.
Target lock. Eliminate.
Tch… I can't outrun this!!
I'll protect you, desu~!!
Like hell I'll let you!!
[MERU]!
[NOEL]!
There's a lot to talk about,\nbut that can wait, desu~!
This power came in handy!
There he is! That idiot!
Where the hell have you been wandering!?
Sorry! It's a long story!
Tsubasa, those enemies!!
They're Mie and Key, but something's different.
Everyone! These seem to be\nmachines built for combat!
In that case,\nI can go all-out!
If it's mechs, no need to hold back!
Yes! I'll take the center!
Let's take 'em down!
Targets, multi-lock. Eliminate.
Targets, multi-lock. Eliminate.
Attack.
Attack.
There's no emotion in their movements at all.\nThey're completely combat machines…
That makes it easier!
Attack.
She was an annoying little brat,\nbut without the noise it's kinda lonely!
Attack.
The kid who loved fun stuff\nturned into such a boring mech —\nthe creator has no taste~.
Attack.
A fist aimed at a heartless foe\ncarries nothing but all the power I've got!!
Attack.
So the replica of the would-be king — who nearly became\nnothing but brute force —\nis now entirely a machine that wields power…
Attack.
Well, it's a well-made mech,\nbut defying me is a thousand years too early!
Attack.
If I could build a robot this good,\nI'd make it mind the shop, rake in cash, and draw doujinshi all day —\nlife would be rosy, nyo~!
All cleaned up.\nLet's fall back to Dokoka Town!
Save the long stories for later.
Phew, once we're in Dokoka Town we're safe.
Welcome back, desu~!
Welcome back, [CLAUDE]!
Still, how did you manage to come\nrescue me at that exact moment?
Remember Polial's property?\nThe one where you go where you wish to go.
So that's how you got to me…?
But until now, even when we went looking,\nwe couldn't find [CLAUDE],\ndesu~?
This time the timing was good, desu~.
But until now, no matter where we went,\n[CLAUDE] wasn't there.\nWhat was different this time?
As for where I've been,\nI'll explain it properly, in order.
And about what I really am, too.
Wha… [CLAUDE] is\nMie and Key's big brother!?
We're not blood-related, but\nin terms of the order we were created,\nI'd be the older brother.
But you're ridiculously weak!\nNothing like Mie and Key!
We were created for different purposes…
Let me get this straight. Our world is really\nmanaged by a computer\ncalled Mother?
Yes. Mother created me and Mie and the others.
So that is the truth of the world…
Then Mie's talk about the spaceship\nwas true?
Yes. Mother also created\nthe Goddess of Destruction.
So it's all that thing's fault?
Let me explain in the order things happened.
First, a giant spaceship containing\nall these many worlds was built.\nA very long time ago.
Though I say spaceship,\nit's about the size of a single star,\nso no one notices it.
I can't even buy the first part.
The computer that manages and operates\nthat giant spaceship is Mother.
What was the spaceship built for?
I don't know that either.\nI'm merely one of those\ncreated by Mother.
I was born to resolve\na problem that occurred in Mother.
A problem?
Gaps appeared in Mother's memory capacity,\nand her behavior became unstable.
To fill in that missing information,\nI was dispatched to the surface to gather information directly\nand deliver it to Mother.
'Was supposed to' — so it failed?
Embarrassingly, I was defective too —\neven after being sent to the surface I never woke up,\nand on top of that I had amnesia.
That's when we met you!\nYou'd just woken up?
That was [CLAUDE]\nwhen we met, desu~?\nYou'd been asleep the whole time…
Mother was already malfunctioning\nwhen she created me, so it can't be helped.
You really are a defective product…
Yes… but Mother created\nthis Dokoka Town and Polial as a set with me.\nThose, at least, work properly.
Mother made this place?
That's weird, right?\nIf Mother made it, Mie and Key should\nknow Dokoka Town exists.
This was made by Mother back when her thinking was still normal,\nto prepare for a future Mother\nthat would be even more broken.
I see — Mother predicted\nthat she would break down\nfurther.
Mother locked Dokoka Town\nand cut it off from her own awareness.
And as the Polial terminal I would use\nto travel between worlds, it became\na quarantined area independent of Mother.
Was Polial\nmade just for you, [CLAUDE]?
Originally. But since I'd forgotten Polial existed,\nshe probably forced jumps to happen\nto make me remember.
That was the beginning\nof our journey, desu~.
So THAT'S what\nthe start of our journey was!
Going back a bit: because I stayed asleep\non the surface and never worked, Mother's\nmemory gaps kept getting worse.
And what the deranged Mother created\nwas the Goddess of Destruction —\nthe thing that returns the world to nothing.
Fearing that advancing memory loss would\nmake operating the spaceship impossible,\nMother built a device to reset the memory banks.
Does that mean wiping\nall the information of the worlds she manages?
Yes… but Mother is only a supervisor —\nshe was never given the authority to return worlds to nothing.
So she implanted the reset device called the Goddess of Destruction\ninto humanity, so that it would awaken\nonce humanity learned the truth of the world.
So she left the destruction switch\nfor humans to press.
But Mother's desire to reset\nkept growing stronger.\nSo she sent Mie and Key to the surface.
To stir up the worlds\nand wake the Goddess of Destruction\nsooner!
But it backfired —\nbecause Mie and Key killed Eve,\nthe Goddess of Destruction awoke incompletely.
Everything Mother does\nfails, nyo…
Indeed… And\nI remembered my purpose\nat the same time the Goddess of Destruction awoke.
So [CLAUDE]'s been\nat Mother's place all this time?
Yes. My purpose is to repair Mother.\nI took the information gathered on our journey\nhoping to make Mother even a little normal.
Did Mother get better?
…If you saw those mass-produced combat sisters of mine,\nyou'd understand how that turned out.
Ah…
Mother has started\nsome new plan again.
I slipped away in that opening\nbecause I had to tell you all the truth.
Thank goodness! If [CLAUDE] hadn't\ncome back,\nwe'd never have known any of this!
Mother is most likely plotting\nto reset humanity and the world.\nWe have to stop her no matter what!
Are you not\none who stands with Mother?
…I am
human.
([CLAUDE]… well said!)
